The force of the water is the most powerful kind, and spirits of the water are mighty and moody beings. Some are helpful, some are cranky, but all are to be respected. column3: 每次听到潜鸟啼鸣，我就想回到湖上，划船去那些曾经度过美好时光的地方。可我那条可靠的平底小舟，如今已经全坏了。

column2: FLAGS TO 1

Fair enough.
Fair enough. I will go after the robbers.
column3: 好吧，我会去追查那些强盗。

column2: Familiar nuisance
Familiar visitor
Farewell now. Maybe our paths will cross again one day.
column3: 告辞了，也许将来某天，我们还会再见。

column2: Farewell, and best of luck to you!
Farewell, you kind soul.
Fell some trees
Fellow
Fellow maiden, that's the way it is. See you around.
column3: 姑娘，事情就是这样。回头见。

column2: Figuring it might be a camp of local woodsman I headed towards the smoke hoping to find someone to ask directions from. But instead of good people I found those robbers sitting by a campfire!
column3: 我以为那可能是本地林人的营地，就循着烟走过去，盼着能找个人问路。可营火旁坐着的不是好人，而是那群强盗！

column2: Finally you had guts to say it out loud. Take care then.
column3: 你总算敢把话直说出来了。那就保重吧。

column2: Fine.
Fine. Bye then.
Fine. Farewell then.
Fine. Let's keep our troubles to ourselves then.
column3: 好吧，那我们就各自操心自己的麻烦。

column2: Fine. Pass out of my way then.
column3: 好吧，那就别挡着我的路。

column2: Fine. So be it.
Fine. You were not the right one.
column3: 好吧，看来你并不是合适的人。

column2: First tell me what happened and I'll think about it.
column3: 先说清楚发生了什么，我再考虑。

column2: Firstly, how does this spirit look like, if he arrives?
column3: 首先，如果那位精灵现身，它是什么模样？

column2: Firstly, what do they look like?
Follow
For all I know it is one of their things.
column3: 据我所知，那是它们拥有的东西之一。

column2: For the time being we keep our goods to ourselves and do not trade with anyone.
column3: 眼下我们要留着这些东西，谁来也不换。

column2: Foreign
Forest Force herbal blend
Forest Maids

Forest maids are pretty and secretive otherworldly forest folk who may sometimes appear to favoured wanderers, especially these days. Pretty maids in pretty dresses, that's what they look like, and what they let be seen is a real delight in the night.
column3: 森林少女是美丽而神秘的异界林中之民，有时会向受到眷顾的旅人现身，尤其是在这些日子里。她们看起来就是穿着漂亮衣裙的美丽姑娘，夜里愿意让人看见的模样，实在赏心悦目。

column2: Forest maids, huh? I wouldn't know.

Get going then. Chop chop.
Gladly.
Go!
Good for you. Let's get started then.
Good luck with that.
Good luck! I'm awaiting for you to return with good news.
column3: 祝你好运！我等着你带好消息回来。

column2: Good luck.
Good that you survived! Where was that?
column3: 幸好你活下来了！那是在什么地方？

column2: Good to hear that passing the knowledge on to you was worthwhile.
column3: 知道把这些知识传给你没有白费，我很高兴。

column2: Good to see you after such a long time!
column3: 好久不见，真高兴见到你！

column2: Good! But this is not all I want.
Good! I follow you. The sooner we reach there the better.
column3: 好，我跟着你。我们越早到越好。

column2: Good! I'm happy to have helped.
Good! Let us go then. The road goes ever on and on...
column3: 好，那就出发吧。前路漫漫，路还长着呢……

column2: Good! Now I'm eager to hear your fishing advices.
column3: 好！现在我很想听听你的捕鱼指点。

column2: Good, I'll go collect the branches. Where do you want me to pile them?
column3: 好，我去收集树枝。你想让我堆在哪里？

column2: Good, good. Enjoy the search.
Good, this is good news
Good, very good!
Good. I am not making this up.
column3: 好。我说的可不是编出来的。

column2: Good. Let me know what he said then.
column3: 好，到时告诉我他说了什么。

column2: Good. Let me know when you are ready to set on our journey, and I will gladly follow you.
column3: 好，准备好出发时告诉我，我很愿意跟你走。

column2: Good. Let's get started then.
Good. My fault that it got loose, but something unexplained made it disappear.
column3: 好。它跑掉是我的过失，但让它消失的，是某种无法解释的力量。

column2: Good. See you then.
Good. Take care now.
Good. Talk to you again then.
Good. Thank you. I'll await for his reply.
column3: 好，谢谢。我会等他的答复。

column2: Good. Then I'll just await for you to deliver me a fine new punt sooner or later.
column3: 好，那我就等着你将来送来一条精良的新平底小舟。

column2: Good. You also mentioned compensating my efforts?
column3: 好。你刚才也提到了给我报酬的事？

column2: Good. You do that.
Group command
Group command off
H.Ask help/company
Hah! Trading! I'm not that kind of a person.
column3: 哈！交易！我可不是那种人。

column2: Hah! You think you're tough guy? Now think again. We are going to rob you anyway - like it or not.
column3: 哈！你以为自己很厉害？再想想吧。不管你乐不乐意，我们都要抢你的东西。

column2: Have you ever met forest maids?
Have you investigated it further?
column3: 你进一步查过这件事了吗？

column2: Have you performed the spell yet?
column3: 你已经施过那道咒语了吗？

column2: Have you've been told about the wolf yet?
column3: 已经有人告诉你那头狼的事了吗？

column2: Haven't seen, or even heard about? Well...
column3: 没见过，甚至没听说过？那么……

column2: Having hesitations?
He
He did.

He invited me to sit next to him after the evening meal and we talked long into the evening. By the time night had fallen and it was time to go to bed the warmth of the hearth fire had kindled flames of affection between us... and so I shared my furs with him.
column3: 晚饭后，他邀我坐在身旁，我们一直聊到很晚。夜幕降临、该就寝的时候，炉火的暖意也点燃了我们之间的情意……于是，我让他与我共眠于毛皮之下。

column2: He knows what is going on, but refuses to reveal me how to remedy the situation in order to protect me from further harm.
column3: 他知道发生了什么，却不肯告诉我如何补救，说是为了保护我，免得我再受到伤害。

column2: He remembers nothing but having fainted outside our village, and then coming back to his senses further in the woods while devouring a bread. Having lost his clothes and being surrounded by wolf tracks he figured what had happened. But he managed to return, I gave him some supplies and he's back in the woods to recover now. I'm about to follow him soon, but first let me reward you with something that only a woman like me can offer.
column3: 他只记得自己在村外昏倒，后来在更深的林子里恢复神志，嘴里还在吃着面包。衣服没了，四周又全是狼的足迹，他便明白了发生过什么。不过他还是设法回来了，我给了他一些补给，现在他又回到森林里休养去了。我很快也会去找他。不过，先让我用一种只有我这样的女人才能给予的东西答谢你。

column2: He said I should bring your reply back to him.
column3: 他让我把你的答复带回去。

column2: Heh, how come you say so?
Heh, sure I do. Doesn't everybody?
column3: 呵，当然知道。难道不是人人都知道吗？

column2: Hehehe...
Here I am if I'm of any use.
column3: 有什么我能帮忙的，尽管说。

column2: Here the essentials are proper location and possessions.
column3: 这件事的要点，是合适的地点和随身的物品。

column2: Here you go.
Here, take this herbal blend. It's good for wounds and makes a healthy herbal beverage too. May we meet again in friendship.
column3: 来，收下这份混合草药。它既能疗伤，也能泡成有益身体的草药饮品。愿我们下次相见，依旧友好。

column2: Hey, it appears that you have got the work done. Good, thank you. Now let's settle that reward of yours, shall we?
column3: 嘿，看来你已经把事情办好了。很好，谢谢你。现在来谈谈给你的报酬吧？

column2: Hmm, I'm not convinced. I won't deliver the message.
column3: 嗯，我还是不信。我不会替你传话。

column2: Hmm, what is this water folk like?
column3: 嗯，水族究竟是什么样的？

column2: Hmm. Maybe I should learn more about them.
column3: 嗯，也许我该多了解他们一些。

column2: Hmm. Maybe so. We will continue the search on our own then.
column3: 嗯，也好。那么我们就自己继续寻找。

column2: Hmm. Right. But forest maids can be unpredictable, and curious.
column3: 嗯，对。不过森林少女难以捉摸，而且很好奇。

column2: Hmm... What is that they come or appear for?
column3: 嗯……她们为什么会来，或者现身呢？

column2: Hmmm... Thinking of it, I might have a task for you.
column3: 嗯……说起来，我或许有件事可以托付给你。

column2: Hmpf.
Hmpf. Begone then.
Hmpf. I do not need your help.
Hmpf. I don't even care to ask why. Bye then.
column3: 哼，我连原因都懒得问了。再见。

column2: Hmpf. I must have been wrong about you.
Hmpf. Well, if you really have to then so be it.
column3: 哼。好吧，如果你非要如此，那就这样吧。

column2: Hmpf. Why don't you just take my advice. That's all I have to say to you about it.
column3: 哼，你为什么就不肯听我的劝呢？关于这件事，我就说这么多。

column2: Hmpf. You seem willing to help, but listen up first.
column3: 哼。你似乎愿意帮忙，不过先听我说完。

column2: Hmph! I though you were reliable when it comes to trading.
column3: 哼！我还以为你做买卖挺可靠。

column2: Hmph. I thought you would have cared.
column3: 哼，我还以为你会在乎呢。

column2: Hmph. We womenfolk have needs too, silly.
column3: 哼，我们女人也有自己的需要，傻瓜。

column2: Ho-hum...sometimes I wish I had faster legs.
column3: 唉……有时真希望自己的腿脚能再快些。

column2: Hold on, I'm just coming to that part!
Homeland robbers
How about the items you had to leave?
column3: 你不得不丢下的那些东西呢？

column2: How can one ever find a particular lone wolf in the wilderness?
column3: 荒野这么大，怎么才能找到那一只独狼？

column2: How can you be so sure?
How can you not believe me! Oh how will this end...
column3: 你怎么能不相信我！唉，这可怎么收场……

column2: How come you got lost like that?
How did the struggle end?
column3: 那场搏斗最后怎么样了？

column2: How did you get that wounded?
column3: 你怎么受了这么重的伤？

column2: How do people get to meet them?
column3: 人们是怎么遇见她们的？

column2: How do people get to meet these spirits?
column3: 人们怎样才能遇见这些精灵？

column2: How do you attract them?
How is it going with the herb picking?
How is it with the punt?
column3: 平底小舟的事怎么样了？

column2: How long does it take? I promised to take the punt to him.
column3: 要多久？我答应过要把平底小舟送给他。

column2: However, the rest of your offer is accepted.
column3: 不过，你提出的其余东西，我接受了。

column2: Huh. I didn't mean no harm, but I'll be gone soon.
column3: 哼，我没有恶意，不过我很快就会走。

column2: I abandoned it right after discovering the theft and left the emptied snares and everything untouched.
column3: 发现猎物被偷以后，我立刻弃用了那片猎场。被掏空的套索陷阱和其他东西都原样留着，没动过。

column2: I am available if my herblore skills are of any use to you.
column3: 如果我的草药知识能派上用场，我愿意帮忙。

column2: I am called
I am hungry. It's your duty to provide me with enough food.
column3: 我饿了。给我提供足够的食物，是你的责任。

column2: I am listening...
I am starving. Some food needs to come my way, and soon!
column3: 我快饿死了，得赶紧给我弄点吃的！

column2: I am thankfully listening.
I believe that is originally ours. Why don't you rather return it to its place.
column3: 我想这原本就是我们的东西。你还是把它放回原处吧。

column2: I can assure my traps have been hit by a bird thief.
column3: 我敢肯定，有个偷鸟贼光顾了我的陷阱。

column2: I can hold a knife if need be but that's about it.
column3: 需要的时候，我倒也能拿把刀，可也就仅此而已了。

column2: I can offer you a dose that will cure anything that ails you. I only have a little bit left at this time of year, but if you help me I'll give you some for your trouble.
column3: 我能给你一剂药，治好你身上的种种病痛。每年这个时候，我手头就只剩一点了。不过，只要你帮忙，我愿意分给你一些，作为酬谢。

column2: I can tell you that. I saw them real close with my own eyes.
column3: 我能告诉你。我亲眼在很近的地方见过他们。

column2: I can tell you where it went, but I can also tell it went missing there for unexplained reasons.
column3: 我能告诉你它去了哪里，不过我也得说，它在那里失踪的原因至今不明。

column2: I can't accept your precious gift unless I can give you something in return. I have this little valuable which is now yours to keep.
column3: 这么贵重的礼物，我不能白收。我有一件小小的珍宝，现在归你了。

column2: I can't thank you enough. Good luck, and let me know how it goes.
column3: 真不知道该怎样谢你。祝你好运，有消息就告诉我。

column2: I caused them some trouble, but I don't know if it was enough to make them leave for good.
column3: 我给他们制造了一些麻烦，不过不知道这是否足以让他们永远离开。

column2: I certainly possess the knowledge and experience but old age doesn't come alone. See, I used to enjoy wandering the shores and groves in search of healing plants and enjoyed being a part of the changing seasons, but nowadays my eyes and knees have gotten too weak to wander far from home. Seeking out the herbs is still a pleasure for me, but unfortunately a time-consuming and painful one.
column3: 知识和经验，我确实都有，可年纪大了，毛病也跟着来了。从前我喜欢沿岸边、穿树林寻找药草，乐于亲身感受四季更替。如今眼睛和膝盖都不行了，走不远。寻找草药依旧令我愉快，可惜也变得既费时又痛苦。

column2: I could talk about it again.
I could try to help you with those injuries.
column3: 你这些伤，我可以试着帮忙医治。

column2: I could use some extra weapons.
I did what you asked, now how about that spell?
column3: 你托付的事我办好了，现在该教我那个咒语了吧？

column2: I do accept your offer. Shall we close the deal then?
column3: 我接受你的出价。那就成交？

column2: I do not trade my goods.
I don't blame you, but be warned.
column3: 我不怪你，不过还是要提醒你当心。

column2: I don't have anything to cook.
column3: 我没有可以烹饪的东西。

column2: I don't have wealth to offer, but I ask you to trust that I'll find a little something precious to give you if you help me and things work out.
column3: 我拿不出丰厚的报酬，但请你相信，只要你帮我，事情又能顺利解决，我一定找一件珍贵的小东西送给你。

column2: I don't know, but they were alert and I wasn't hidden.
column3: 我不知道，不过他们很警觉，而我当时没有藏身。

column2: I don't know.
I don't suspect anyone specifically, but I certainly want the thief to be revealed in a righteous manner. But if I go asking around I fear it might cause bad blood among the neighbourhood.
column3: 我并没有明确怀疑谁，但我一定要用公正的办法揪出那个贼。可要是自己四处打听，又怕伤了邻里和气。

column2: I don't take commands from robbers! But I'm no hero either...
column3: 我可不听强盗的命令！不过我也不是什么英雄……

column2: I don't think concerns me at all.
I don't think it is that important.
I don't want to be greedy so it's best that you make the offer.
column3: 我不想贪得无厌，还是由你来出价吧。

column2: I don't want to bother you anyway.
I doubt you have enough to complete this trade, but I'm somewhat interested in your
column3: 我怀疑你带的东西不够完成这笔交易，不过我对你的

column2: I escaped the beast, but left my equipment at the shelter. Remember?
column3: 我逃过了那头野兽，却把装备留在了棚屋那里。记得吗？

column2: I expect you to hand out some decent goods at once to pay for my services.
column3: 我希望你马上拿些像样的货物，付清我的工钱。

column2: I feel this is not for me, after all.
column3: 想来想去，我觉得这事还是不适合我。

column2: I fought them hard and cut down at least some of them.
column3: 我和他们拼了一场，至少砍倒了其中几个人。

column2: I guess I have to believe what you say.
column3: 看来我只能相信你的话了。

column2: I guess I'm not done just yet.
I guess all is well then.

I guess now we just have to wait for the results. Whoever the thief might be I'm under impression he should now come to me and confess. Maybe after few days we'll know who it was, so let's wait and talk again after a while.
column3: 我想现在只须等结果了。不论那个贼是谁，按理说他现在应该来找我坦白了。也许过几天就能知道是谁，我们等一等，过些时候再谈。

column2: I guess somebody made a spell. I got burning hot, kept sweating all day long and could barely sleep at all. After few days of suffering I just had to go and confess, and after that my condition relieved.
column3: 我想是有人施了咒。我浑身滚烫，整天冒汗，几乎睡不了觉。熬了几天，实在受不了，只好去坦白；之后症状就减轻了。

column2: I guess the bird thief case isn't solved yet, or let me know if you've figured out something.
column3: 看来偷鸟贼的事还没有解决。你要是发现了什么，记得告诉我。

column2: I had a good look at them from an unpleasantly close distance.
column3: 我在近得令人不安的地方，把他们看了个清楚。

column2: I had been travelling for a week, and stopped for a night. I made a quick shelter and slept tight.
column3: 我走了一个星期，停下来过夜。匆匆搭了个棚屋，就沉沉睡去了。

column2: I had nothing but my knife to wield as I had left everything else by the shelter.
column3: 其他东西全留在棚屋旁了，我手里只有一把刀。

column2: I happen to know some fishing tricks and spells that you too might appreciate. Give me a hand here and I'll teach you some for the trouble.
column3: 我知道一些捕鱼的窍门和咒语，你应该也会感兴趣。你帮我一把，我就教给你，算是酬谢。

column2: I have a log.
I have been trapping birds quite successfully for a long time but lately I started to find my snares emptied. Consistently. Somebody keeps stealing my winged prey.
column3: 很长一段时间，我捕鸟都很顺利。可最近套索陷阱却接连被掏空。有人一直在偷我捕到的鸟。

column2: I have met a few of both during my time, and I also know the means to deal with them both if need be.
column3: 这两种存在，我这些年都见过几个。必要时，我也知道该如何应付它们。

column2: I have never had much luck with anything, so... But it's over now, and this is all I have to say about it.
column3: 我的运气从来都不怎么样，所以……不过事情已经过去了，我也就说这么多。

column2: I have no idea if there are any.
I have no time for bleeding-heart maidens. There's a wolf in the area in need of killing.
column3: 我没空管那些多愁善感的姑娘。这一带有只狼，得有人去杀掉它。

column2: I have some goods to trade.
I have the log.
I have to ask you to drop our goods now!
column3: 请你现在就放下我们的东西！

column2: I have to think about this
I have to trust you.
I haven't seen you much around here lately!
column3: 最近很少见你在这附近啊！

column2: I heard you have met a forest maid.
I heard you met some robbers?
column3: 听说你遇上了一些强盗？

column2: I hope so.
I hope so. I've been asking among the trusted wise men here.
column3: 但愿如此。我一直在向这里值得信赖的智者打听。

column2: I hope you do.
I hope you find a helping hand. It's not me, though.
column3: 希望有人肯帮你，不过那个人不是我。

column2: I hope you get it back one day, though I can't help you.
column3: 虽然我帮不上忙，还是希望你有一天能找回它。

column2: I hope you recover soon, but what exactly happened?
column3: 希望你早日康复。不过，到底发生了什么？

column2: I just might go after them, if there is a reward?
column3: 如果有报酬，我倒可能去追他们。

column2: I just thought we would have helped each others.
column3: 我只是以为我们能互相帮助。

column2: I kept running aimlessly and managed to escape unharmed.
column3: 我没头没脑地一路跑，总算毫发无伤地逃了出来。

column2: I kind of hoped that you could have helped me with this matter.
column3: 我原本还希望你能帮我处理这件事。

column2: I knew you would. Let's get started then.
column3: 我就知道你会答应。那么开始吧。

column2: I might try to help you...but would you compensate my efforts somehow?
column3: 我可以试着帮你……不过，你会给我些报酬吗？

column2: I must hurry.
I must warn you for there are robbers around our forests.
column3: 我得提醒你，我们这片森林里有强盗。

column2: I need a day or two to prepare.
I only trap birds, and now I've given it up until the thief is revealed - but yes. Want to see it for yourself?
column3: 我只捕鸟。如今贼还没找出来，我已经停手了——不过，确实有。想亲自去看看吗？

column2: I really don't feel like wanting to wait you here in the wilderness.
column3: 我实在不想在这荒野里等你。

column2: I really need to find someone to help me in restocking my herb stores.
column3: 我真得找个人，帮我补充储存的草药。

column2: I really went after him and did as advised, but..huh..I'm still astounded by all this.
column3: 我确实去找了他，也照着指点做了，可是……唉……这一切还是让我惊讶不已。

column2: I reckon the forest was pleased with me, as were the forest maids. Sometimes they told where the game was, sometimes shared the night and the fire with me. My days of appealing to forest maids are long gone, but oh how I long and enjoy to hear stories and sightings of them.
column3: 我想森林是喜欢我的，森林少女也是。有时她们告诉我猎物在哪里，有时会和我共度一夜，守着同一堆火。我吸引森林少女的日子早已过去，可我仍多么渴望听见关于她们的故事和见闻。

column2: I saw the wolf once at the edge of the forest and it looked at me with the eyes of the adventurer. Oh, he needs to be found and made a man again before it is too late. Can I put my hope in you?
column3: 我在森林边见过那只狼一次，它望着我，眼神和那个冒险者一模一样。唉，得赶在太迟以前找到他，让他重新变回人。你能让我把希望寄托在你身上吗？

column2: I see you have an eye for herbs. I just might have use for your knowledge of herblore if you're interested.
column3: 看得出你认得草药。如果你有兴趣，你的草药知识或许能帮上我的忙。

column2: I see you have done a good share of fishing during your days, so I reckoned it's time for somebody to share the lore about water folk with you. See, I would be glad to tell you the essentials about lake dwellers and spirits of the water. The things that you must learn eventually, if you are to get along well with the water folk.
column3: 看得出，你这些年没少捕鱼。我想，也该有人把水族的知识传授给你了。我很乐意告诉你湖中居民和水中精灵的基本常识。想和水族相处融洽，这些事你迟早得懂。

column2: I see you survived, so let's waste no more time. Just tell me where you met them?
column3: 看来你活下来了，那就别耽搁。快告诉我，你在哪里遇见他们的？

column2: I see, and I am all ears.
I see, and then what?
I see, and will gladly listen to you.
column3: 明白了，我很乐意听你讲。

column2: I see, but now I just want to hear what happened from you.
column3: 明白了，不过现在我只想听你亲口说说经过。

column2: I see, but what is that they come or appear for?
column3: 明白了，可她们为什么会来，或者现身呢？

column2: I see. Anything else I should know about?
column3: 明白了。还有什么我该知道的吗？

column2: I see. Good to know this.
I see. I have also thought about giving up trapping once and for all.
column3: 明白了。我也曾想过彻底不再设陷阱。

column2: I see. Just let me know if there is something simple I could do on my own.
column3: 明白了。如果有什么简单的事是我自己能做的，就告诉我。

column2: I see. Just say if there's something I could help you with?
column3: 明白了。有什么我能帮忙的，尽管说。

column2: I see. Maybe not the smartest thing to do, huh?
column3: 明白了。或许那不是个明智的做法，对吧？

column2: I see. So where do my herblore skills come into picture?
column3: 明白了。那么，我的草药知识能帮上什么忙？

column2: I see. You want me to travel with you?
column3: 明白了。你想让我陪你一起走？

column2: I shall name you...
I speak of it only with bird hunters. If you need to know then prove yourself worthy. Go hunt a bird, bring it to me and then we'll talk.
column3: 我只和捕鸟人谈这件事。你若想知道，就先证明自己配得上。去猎一只鸟，带来给我，然后我们再谈。

column2: I surely hope I can trust you this time.
I take it his charm worked on you too, hmm?
column3: 看来，你也被他的魅力打动了，是吧？

column2: I take the warning and try to avoid ever meeting them.
column3: 我会记住这个警告，尽量不和他们碰面。

column2: I think I can do that.
I think I can do that. And what is the message to be delivered?
column3: 我想我能做到。要传达什么话？

column2: I think I have met the spirit of the water!
I think I'd like to have more food with me.
column3: 我想身边还是得多带点食物。

column2: I think I'm up to the task.
column3: 我想我能胜任这个任务。

column2: I think it's best if you make the offers now.
column3: 我想现在还是由你来出价比较好。

column2: I think we could come to an agreement if you would give me your
I think you are mistaken. I do not own the animals around here.
column3: 我想你弄错了，这附近的动物不归我所有。

column2: I think you simply don't have enough valuable goods to complete this trade.
column3: 我想你根本没有足够贵重的货物来完成这笔交易。

column2: I told it all.
I told you my story, and he is the one who can confirm.
column3: 我把自己的经历告诉你了，他可以作证。

column2: I truly met a forest maid last year while working in the woods. Sleeping under the open sky I woke up one night to a pretty maid standing next to my campfire, smiling at me. Then she came and snuggled beside me. I was mesmerized by her beauty, and soon fell asleep again.
column3: 去年在林中干活时，我真遇见过一位森林少女。那天我露天而眠，夜里醒来，看见一个漂亮姑娘站在篝火旁对我微笑。随后她走过来，依偎在我身边。我被她的美貌迷住，不久又睡着了。

column2: I trust you did your best and this encourages us to continue the pursuit if need be.
column3: 我相信你已经尽力了。这也鼓舞了我们，必要时继续追捕。

column2: I understand. But what can you do?
column3: 我明白。可你能做什么呢？

column2: I understand. Bye then.
I warn you not neglect me again or I will head elsewhere.
column3: 我警告你，别再不管我，否则我就另找去处。

column2: I was bleeding bad, but determined to survive and crawled my way to this village.
column3: 我流了很多血，但一心要活下去，便一路爬到了这个村子。

column2: I was fortunate to meet a few during my younger years.
column3: 年轻时，我有幸见过几位。

column2: I was freezing and frightened and barely found back to the camp, only to notice that I couldn't remember where I had left my axe. So, unfortunately I had to return back to the village. That's it. Now if you too are about to laugh behind me back go ask my uncle about these things.
column3: 我又冷又怕，好不容易才回到营地，却发现自己不记得把斧头丢在哪里了。没办法，只好回村。就是这样。要是你也想在背后笑我，就去问问我叔叔这些事。

column2: I was hoping to hear that

I was lost in the woods when I met them and then ran for my life without watching scenery.
column3: 遇见他们时，我已经在树林里迷了路，后来又只顾逃命，根本没留意周围的景物。

column2: I was roaming a familiar trail, and then all of a sudden I couldn't recognize the terrain anymore. The forest got completely silent and I felt like I was walking in a thick fog. I ended up just circling around aimlessly for days. I'm not sure, but maybe I had gotten in the forest cover. Then it went away and the forest seemed familiar again, but I'm still so very disoriented.
column3: 我正沿着一条熟悉的小路走，突然就认不出周围的地形了。整片森林静得出奇，我感觉像走在浓雾里。接下来几天，我一直漫无目的地打转。我不敢肯定，也许是遭到了森林遮隐。后来那种感觉消失了，森林也重新变得熟悉，可我至今仍辨不清方向。

column2: I will do my best.
I will do what it takes.
column3: 无论如何，我都会尽力做到。

column2: I will remember you. Farewell.
I will, as soon as you make sure I have proper equipment and there are proper trunks around.
column3: 只要你替我备好合适的工具，并确保附近有合适的树干，我就会动手。

column2: I will, as soon as you make sure I have proper equipment and we have proper trees around here.
column3: 只要你替我备好合适的工具，并确保附近有合适的树木，我就会动手。

column2: I wish you better times in the future, but this is not my problem.
column3: 希望你以后能过得好些，不过这不关我的事。

column2: I won't go nowhere. This place doesn't belong to you.
column3: 我哪儿也不去。这地方又不属于你。

column2: I wonder how is the appearance of the forest spirit then?
column3: 那么，森林之灵是什么模样？

column2: I would have appreciated to get something in return.
column3: 要是能有些回报，我会很感激。

column2: I would like to, but I need to think about the way to do so.
column3: 我愿意，不过得想想该怎么做。

column2: I would like you to pay for the goods you've got.
column3: 你拿走的那些货物，我希望你付清价钱。

column2: I would still like to help if I can.
column3: 如果能帮上忙，我还是愿意的。

column2: I wouldn't even care to mention, but well, you may meet her anyway.
column3: 我本来懒得提起，不过，你说不定还是会遇见她。

column2: I'd like to hear more about this wolf?
I'll be here.
I'll be staying here unless you command me otherwise.
column3: 除非你另有指示，我会待在这里。

column2: I'll bring them to you soon.
column3: 我很快就会把它们带来。

column2: I'll do it, but I expect to be paid too.
column3: 我愿意做，不过也希望能得到报酬。

column2: I'll lay low now and hope that you'll learn to do what it takes. Oh, and visit my last trapping site if you need to examine the traces of theft.
column3: 我先安静等着，希望你能学会该怎么做。哦，要检查偷盗留下的痕迹，就去我上次设陷阱的地方看看。

column2: I'll see about it.
I'll wait.
I'm
I'm a mere negotiator between the people and the spirit world.
column3: 我不过是人们与灵界之间的传话人。

column2: I'm afraid I can't help you.
I'm afraid I'm unable to light a proper fire here.
column3: 恐怕我没法在这里生起一堆像样的火。

column2: I'm afraid I'm unable to set and light a proper fire here.
column3: 恐怕我没法在这里搭好柴堆并生起一堆像样的火。

column2: I'm afraid there is nothing I can do to help you.
I'm afraid there is nothing butcher here. Bring me at a carcass if there is one.
column3: 恐怕这里没有可以分割的猎物。要是有兽尸，拿来给我吧。

column2: I'm afraid they still just might be lurking in the woods....
column3: 恐怕他们仍潜伏在树林里……

column2: I'm all ears now.
I'm awaiting good news about the robber chase...
column3: 我正等着追捕强盗的好消息……

column2: I'm begging you, please don't hunt that wolf. You don't understand what is really going on here.
column3: 求求你，别猎杀那只狼。你并不了解这里究竟发生了什么。

column2: I'm familiar with this region and I'm pretty sure of it.
column3: 我熟悉这一带，对这件事很有把握。

column2: I'm happy to leave with my current equipment.
column3: 带着现在这些装备离开，我已经满意了。

column2: I'm happy to leave with my current equipment. If you let me keep it now my services are paid for.
column3: 带着现在这些装备离开，我已经满意了。只要让我把它们留下，就算付清了我的工钱。

column2: I'm in no hurry.
I'm known as
I'm not afraid of no wolf.
I'm not happy to leave with my current equipment. I expect you to hand out some decent goods to pay for my services. Let's settle this today.
column3: 只带着现在这些装备离开，我可不满意。我希望你拿些像样的货物支付工钱。我们今天就把这事结清吧。

column2: I'm not too eager to run after stray animals.
column3: 我不太想去追走失的牲畜。

column2: I'm ready. Let us go now.
column3: 我准备好了。现在就走吧。

column2: I'm really sorry. Something came up and I couldn't make it this time.
column3: 实在抱歉，出了点事，这次没能做出来。

column2: I'm soothsayer old as time. I know more than I can even remember.
column3: 我是个年深日久的预言者，知道的事多得连自己都未必记得。

column2: I'm sorry but I can't take that. It's too much for me to carry.
column3: 抱歉，我收不了。我已经拿不动那么多东西了。

column2: I'm sorry, but I can't do it.
I'm sorry, but I have to give up on this.
I'm sorry, but I just don't know the area that well.
column3: 对不起，我对这一带实在不熟。

column2: I'm sorry. There's a bug. I can't forge that.
column3: 抱歉，程序出了问题，我锻造不了那件东西。

column2: I'm still curious about that wolf.
column3: 我还是对那只狼很好奇。

column2: I'm still working to get it solved.
column3: 我还在设法解决这件事。

column2: I'm very grateful for this.
I'm working on it.
I'm working on to find and fetch your herbs.
column3: 我正在设法找到并带回你的草药。

column2: I'm your companion, not somebody to trade with.
column3: 我是你的同伴，可不是和你做买卖的人。

column2: I've been fishing for as long as I can remember. But now my dear old punt is broken. Oh, woe and sorrow! It was such a good punt!
column3: 打我记事起，我就在捕鱼。可如今，我心爱的老平底小舟坏了。唉，真是伤心！那本来是多好的一条船啊！

column2: I've been waiting for someone brave to step forward and go chase them away.
column3: 我一直在等一个勇敢的人站出来，把他们赶走。

column2: I've been watching you.
I've done the best I can for you. The time will show how well I succeeded. Try to rest now.
column3: 我已经尽力医治了。效果究竟怎样，要过些时日才知道。现在尽量休息吧。

column2: I've found footprints and feathers by the triggered snares, but never any bloodscapes to indicate the birds being taken by animals. If you need to see it for yourself you can visit my last trapping site.
column3: 触发的套索陷阱旁有脚印和羽毛，却从没见过血迹，不像是野兽叼走了鸟。你若想亲眼确认，可以去我上次设陷阱的地方看看。

column2: I've had my share already.
column3: 我已经得到过自己的那一份了。

column2: I've had my share of this lucky charm and I hope it turns out to be a fine reward for you.
column3: 这件护身符带给我的好运已经够多了，希望它对你来说也是一份好报酬。

column2: If I can make it I expect to be rewarded.
column3: 如果我能办成，希望能得到报酬。

column2: If I get lost again. It was so strange.
column3: 我怕自己再次迷路。那种感觉太奇怪了。

column2: If I was lost already now it took two full days to relocate myself and find finally a way back home.
column3: 这下我彻底迷失了方向，整整花了两天，才重新辨清位置，终于找到回家的路。

column2: If that's all you can tell me it's a long shot to find it.
column3: 如果你只能提供这么多线索，要找到它可不容易。

column2: If that's so is there anything left to be done at all?
column3: 如果是这样，还有什么可做的呢？

column2: If that's the case what there is to be done about it?
column3: 如果是这样，该怎么办呢？

column2: If there was say a bird thief, are there spells to reveal him?
column3: 比方说有个偷鸟贼，有没有能揭穿他的咒语？

column2: If they ever reward you with something it's usually to be found behind nearby trees or so. Whatever you may receive, keep it to yourself and never tell anyone how you got it. Otherwise it disappears or gets ruined.
column3: 如果她们送你礼物，通常就在附近的树后面之类的地方。不论得到什么，都要自己留着，绝不能告诉别人是怎么得来的，否则东西就会消失或者毁坏。

column2: If you like the goods around here, just pick up the ones you need and come talk to me about trading for them.
column3: 你要是看上了这里的货物，就拿起需要的东西，来找我谈怎么换。

column2: If you say so then I won't bother you with this any longer.
column3: 既然你这么说，那我就不再为这事打扰你了。

column2: If you want to lose some blood too then so'll be it. Now, for the last time, will you hand over your stuff?
column3: 你要是还想流点血，那就随你。最后问一遍，交不交出东西？

column2: If you're in a need of metalworks feel free to ask.
column3: 需要锻造金属器物的话，尽管开口。

column2: In the forest cover, huh?
In the past, yes, but not lately.
In this case it comes down to relying on designated spells.
column3: 这种时候，就得借助专门的咒语。

column2: In this case it does.
Indeed, don't we all?
Indeed. You need that log.
Is that so?
Is there some benefit in it for me?
Islander
It can't be found, it needs to be carved.
column3: 找不到现成的，得自己雕出来。

column2: It depends. They treat you and speak to you as they find you.
column3: 这要看情况。她们会根据对你的看法，决定如何待你、如何与你说话。

column2: It had to be done.
It happens if it happens.

It is evident that you can find the trails and hunt the game, so the spirits of the forest surely have been fond of you at times. But the spirit of the forest is also a ruler you better know closely if you are to thrive in his realm. So, I reckoned it's time for somebody to tell you the essentials about these matters. I've watched you, and I consider you worthy of the lore.
column3: 显然，你懂得追踪、猎取野兽，森林里的精灵一定也曾眷顾过你。但森林之灵也是这片领地的统治者；想在他的领域里过得好，就该好好了解他。所以我想，是时候有人告诉你这些基本常识了。我一直留意着你，认为你配得上这份知识。

column2: It is not a long tale at all.
It might be that someone else would know better.
column3: 也许别人知道得更清楚。

column2: It might be wise to keep guard around here.
column3: 在这一带保持警惕，或许是明智之举。

column2: It must be you who kept stealing birds around here some time ago.
column3: 前些时候一直在这里偷鸟的，一定就是你。

column2: It must have been a very special punt to you.

column2: It was all strange.
It was nice to know you.
It was so very strange.
It was.
It would be great if you could.
column3: 你要是能做到，那就太好了。

column2: It's actually partial reason for my success with birds, but now I think my lucky catches also made people envious.
column3: 我捕鸟顺利，也有它的一份功劳。不过现在想来，我的好运也招来了别人的嫉妒。

column2: It's been too much of hopping around, keeping up with all the chores around here.
column3: 这里的杂活太多，我整天东奔西跑，实在忙不过来。

column2: It's for the work well done. Take care now.
column3: 这是酬谢你把事情办得这么好。保重。

column2: It's good to see you again!
It's hard to decide but at this point, how about your

column2: Just a little something for your legs too.

column2: Just fine.

column2: Just try to hang on, I'm working hard to save him.

column2: We met that evening by the light of the fireside, and to my eyes he was the most handsome man I had ever seen. He had a way about him that made the village men listen to his words. There was a look in his eye that drew all the womenfolk - young and old - to flutter and fawn about him.

column2: We want furs - tanned furs. Thick and fine furs of the north. You understand?
